root_cause.text: The gve driver dynamically resized the shared memory region for stats reporting based on the current number of queues, while the NIC's offset calculation assumed a fixed maximum size, causing out-of-bounds writes when queues increased and misaligned reads when queues decreased.

The CVE description confirms that increasing queue count leads to NIC writing past the allocated region, while decreasing queue count creates a gap for incorrect stats reporting.
